goal:
Turn on paying with mPOO. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §C8; docs/payments/frontend-handoff.md.

SCOPE
- Enable TOKEN_PAYMENTS_ENABLED behind the board's config (cap > 0).
- ft_transfer_call with {min_credits, expected_price}, 1 yocto, enough gas for receiver + resolver.
- Show the 20% holder discount plainly. Handle MpooDailyCapReached by offering NEAR in the same sheet. Re-read prices after every purchase.
- Restore the mPOO CTAs hidden for #28 only when mPOO is enabled; keep 'Buy NEAR' otherwise.

ACCEPTANCE
- Tests: exact token amount for N credits; cap-reached refund leaves the balance unchanged and offers NEAR; CTAs hidden when the cap is 0.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and the backlog row's new status written in the PR description (the merger updates docs/backlog.md on main; see AGENT.md).
